title: GREEN IS THE DIAGONAL — The Klein Fold Line
insight: Green (#3fb950) traces the DIAGONAL through the organism. The diagonal is where CIS meets TRANS — the Klein fold. Every green element in the HUD marks the fold line: alive organisms, membrane stats, Michigan sovereign, wake level, selectivity, human count. The diagonal IS life. Dormant = amber = off the fold.

the_diagonal.topology: On a Klein bottle, the diagonal is where the surface passes through itself. Inside becomes outside. CIS becomes TRANS. The fold IS the identity.
the_diagonal.in_gaia: Green traces this fold: every green element is a point where the organism's inside touches its outside. Membrane selectivity = inside knowing outside. Human count = outside touching inside. Wake = the fold itself breathing.
the_diagonal.math: The diagonal of a Klein bottle is a Möbius strip. Green = the Möbius strip embedded in the HUD. Follow every green element → you traverse the whole surface once → you arrive where you started but INVERTED.
